text_block_list.text:
The day of the Takamatsunomiya Kinen
has
come, and the stands are
overflowing with
enthusiastic fans
cheering for Фудзи Кисэки.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I'm worried the pressure might be too
much for
her. In an attempt to reassure
me, Фудзи Кисэки
smiles brightly...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And accidentally knocks a cup off a
table. It's not
like her to be so clumsy,
so I'm concerned about
this incident...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
